title: Sunlit Pixel
description: Un style pixel art nostalgique 16 à 32 bits, caractérisé par un crénelage aux bords nets et une palette de couleurs restreinte et baignée de soleil. L'éclairage est défini par de forts contrastes directionnels et des ombres portées en blocs, créant de la profondeur via des grappes de pixels sans anticrénelage.
description_en: A nostalgic 16-bit to 32-bit pixel art style characterized by hard-edged aliasing and a restricted, sun-drenched color palette. Lighting is defined by strong directional contrasts and blocky cast shadows, creating depth through pixel clusters rather than anti-aliasing.
description_fr: Un style pixel art nostalgique 16 à 32 bits, caractérisé par un crénelage aux bords nets et une palette de couleurs restreinte et baignée de soleil. L'éclairage est défini par de forts contrastes directionnels et des ombres portées en blocs, créant de la profondeur via des grappes de pixels sans anticrénelage.
prompt: Digital 16-bit to 32-bit pixel art. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Rendered entirely on a strict pixel grid with zero anti-aliasing. Forms are constructed using distinct pixel clusters, blocky shading, and sharp color boundaries instead of drawn outlines. The lighting anatomy features intense, highly directional sunlight that produces stark, hard-edged cast shadows and brilliant highlights. Use a nostalgic, sun-drenched palette where {{primary_color}} sets the dominant environmental tone, vibrant {{accent_color}} defines the areas hit by direct light beams, and deep {{secondary_color}} anchors the heavy, structural shadows. Edges exhibit classic staircase aliasing on all diagonals and curves, maintaining a crisp, chunky resolution. Transitions between values avoid smooth gradients, relying instead on solid color blocking and minimal, strategic dithering. Spatial depth is achieved through planar layering and precise pixel stair-stepping to force perspective. The atmosphere is warm, serene, and evocative of classic retro video game environments. 16-bit pixel art, 32-bit aesthetic, aliased edges, hard cast shadows, retro game graphics, pixel clusters, grid-based rendering, sunlit atmosphere, planar perspective, high contrast, blocky shading, digital mosaic, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.

video.motion: Elements animate with rigid, low-framerate sprite updates, moving in strict pixel increments rather than smooth sub-pixel interpolation. Lighting changes occur in distinct stepped color bands.
video.camera: Camera movement is restricted to rigid horizontal or vertical scrolling, locking to the pixel grid without smooth easing.
video.temporal_texture: The pixel grid remains absolutely static and locked to the screen space, with no shimmering or anti-aliasing artifacts introduced during movement.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 60fps interpolation, sub-pixel movement, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and modern dynamic lighting gradients.
